name: loomarr-web-workspace
description: Loomarr client workspace. Shipping Vite web plus the gated Expo/Tamagui shared-client migration.

scripts.codegen: pnpm tokens && pnpm api && pnpm routes
scripts.clients:check: turbo run doctor typecheck test --filter=@loomarr/mobile... --filter=@loomarr/tv... && turbo run bundle --filter=@loomarr/mobile --filter=@loomarr/tv && turbo run client-proof --filter=@loomarr/web
scripts.lint: biome check && pnpm imports:check && pnpm lint:boundaries
scripts.lint:boundaries: depcruise apps/web/src apps/mobile/app apps/tv/src packages/*/*.ts packages/*/src packages/*/tests
